title: Drop From the End
statement: A queue of customers is a linked list. The customer k-th from the end has left. Remove that node and return the head of the list, in one pass.

answerKey.pattern: Two pointers with a fixed gap
keyPoints: Start both at a dummy node before the head
Move both until fast is on the last node
slow.next is the node to remove: slow.next = slow.next.next
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Count the length, then walk to the node before: two passes

hints: How can you know the node is k from the end without counting first?
Keep a gap of k nodes between two pointers.
Start both at a dummy node; move fast k steps, then both until fast.next is null; unlink slow.next.
